text: M70 QA VERDICT WAS HOLD AND IT WAS CORRECT. M70 could not have applied to production: managed Supabase grants arwdDxtm on every new public table to anon, authenticated and service_role via ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES, M70 carried zero table-level revokes, and its own post-condition would have counted 112 grants and aborted. Fixed at 095c6c3f with the house revoke pattern, deliberately not revoking service_role because the deployed Pack 02 store queries these tables directly as that role. Re-certified 12/12 on PG16 and PG17 against a fixture that now replicates the production default ACL. THE LESSON FOR EVERY FUTURE MIGRATION HARNESS IN THIS REPO: a fixture that creates the Supabase ROLES but not the Supabase DEFAULT ACLS will report a clean grant boundary that the real target does not have, and any zero-browser-grants assertion made against it is vacuous. Copy the default-ACL block from scripts/verify-m70-account-organizations.sh. ALSO CORRECTED: the claim that the Pack 02 schema is inert until the account API is mounted is FALSE. The API is unconditional at server/index.ts:283 in the production tree at b0fe396 and its nine routes are wall-exempt, so applying M70 alone flips two endpoints from 503 to live, one of which writes rows and sends outbound email through Resend. Release ordering between apply and deploy is now a founder decision. The earlier QA verdict applies to the BROKEN version and does not certify 095c6c3f; a second independent pass is needed.
